free_tier.stated: No standing free tier. The L40S page says new customers can claim free credits, for example up to INR 20,000 in India or USD 200 globally, for a limited period; the credit is requested through a details form that sends access steps by email.

per_object_cap.notes: a machine record: the ceiling that matters is the flavour shape (vCPU, RAM, GPU count) listed in notes

retention.notes: hourly billing stops when the server is deprovisioned; monthly plans bill for the whole month

egress.terms: AceCloud offers unmetered bandwidth and does not charge for data transfers.

interface_detail: the L40S page states instances launch through the AceCloud console or via API; the API was not probed
tooling: a customer console at customer.acecloud.ai; the L40S page states instances can be launched 'through the AceCloud console or via API'. No client library or CLI is named on the pages read.
chaining: GPU capacity is sold in INR with hourly billing on select cards (L40S from INR 142.12 an hour on-demand, L4 from INR 30 an hour on Spot) and monthly flavours for the datacenter cards. It composes with its own unmetered egress for jobs that move a lot of data; it does not give a free GPU beyond a one-off credit of up to INR 20,000 or USD 200.

limits.value: the only free capacity is a one-off credit of up to INR 20,000 in India or USD 200 globally for a limited period, against a 1x H100 at INR 180,000 a month, a 1x A100 80GB at INR 90,000 a month and an L40S from INR 142.12 an hour

limits_note: the credit is a trial amount that cannot carry a month of any datacenter card; the H100 has no hourly rate on the pricing table
binding_note: the credit is a trial amount that cannot carry a month of any datacenter card; the H100 has no hourly rate on the pricing table

identity_cost.detail: The account-creation form asks for first name, last name, a phone number verified by a one-time code ('Verify your phone number to continue'), email and password. Payment is by UPI, credit card or debit card for customers in India and by credit or debit card only for international customers. Whether a card must be on file before a GPU can be launched is unverified: behind a sign-up. Whether the phone check accepts a non-Indian number is unverified.

reliability_note: unverified: no status page or incident history was read

notes: Per-card rates on the vendor's own pages, all in INR and excluding taxes. H100 80GB HGX: INR 180,000 a month for 1x (26 vCPU, 250 GB RAM), no hourly rate published (the Hourly column reads '---'). A100 80GB: INR 90,000 a month for 1x (16 vCPU, 128 GB RAM). L40S 48GB: INR 142.12 an hour 'starting at' on-demand, INR 83,000 a month for 1x (16 vCPU, 64 GB RAM). L4 24GB: INR 30 an hour 'starting at' on Spot (reclaimable), INR 36,730 a month for 1x (8 vCPU, 32 GB RAM). RTX 4090: not offered on the pages read. The Noida data center prices are shown; Mumbai, Atlanta and custom quotes are on the main pricing page. A third-party index (reported) lists the 1x L40S at USD 1.87 an hour. Egress is free and unmetered.
